opening.title: Community & Distribution Manager
opening.summary: Make our Telegram the most trusted room in Nigerian crypto.
opening.about: You run the community, answer fast, keep scammers out, and get Nasfam Pay in front of audiences we do not own through creator and ambassador partnerships.
requirements: You use crypto and can answer a gas-fee or swap question correctly, in public.
You have moderated a real community through a bad day.
You write clearly and calmly under pressure.
You spot a scam or impersonation attempt instantly.
Based in Nigeria, with your own phone and laptop.
niceToHave: Existing relationships with Nigerian crypto creators.
You have coordinated a paid influencer deal end to end.
Comfortable on camera for community updates.
success: Day 30: median first reply under 15 minutes, scam policy written and enforced.
Day 60: first creator collaboration live with attribution attached.
Day 90: two or three collaborations measured, with an honest verdict on each.
